first_step_test: A low uneven shell with a flat resting edge fixes the geode's scale and stance before any interior detail.

source.notes: One reviewed six-panel handmade graphite and restrained colored-pencil contact sheet; rejected iterations retained privately.

final_elements.name: outer shell
final_elements.description: One low, irregular oval rock silhouette with a short flat bottom in its final position.

final_elements.name: inset cavity
final_elements.description: One scalloped inset opening inside the shell, with a continuous visible rock rim.

final_elements.name: five crystals
final_elements.description: Exactly five unequal triangular crystal points rooted along the bottom of the cavity; their tips stay fixed.

final_elements.name: crystal facets
final_elements.description: One or two straight facet edges inside each of the five existing crystal points.

final_elements.name: shell texture
final_elements.description: Sparse graphite grain on the existing outer shell and a short broken ground shadow beneath its flat base.

frames.visible_job: Draw one low irregular oval with a short flat bottom.
frames.instruction: Begin left of center, curve over three small uneven bumps, come down the right side, and join the ends with a short flat resting edge. Keep the top open inside for the cavity.

frames.visible_job: Add one scalloped inset opening and a visible thickness of stone around it.
frames.instruction: Inside the outer shell, start near the upper left and sweep a shallow scalloped oval toward the upper right, then close it above the flat base. Leave an uneven band of rock between this opening and the outside edge.

frames.visible_job: Add five unequal triangular points rooted along the lower inside edge.
frames.instruction: From the lower edge of the cavity, draw five attached triangles: short, tall, middle, tall, short. Return each side to the same lower edge and leave gaps between their tips.

frames.visible_job: Place straight inner facet edges within the five established points.
frames.instruction: Inside each of the five triangles, draw one slim straight line from its tip toward its base; add a second line only to the two tallest points. Keep all five outer crystal edges in place.

frames.visible_job: Add sparse shell stipples and a short broken ground shadow.
frames.instruction: Scatter a few uneven pencil dots and short hatches on the outer rock band, then place a short broken graphite shadow directly below the flat base. Do not mark over the crystal facets.

final_step.visible_job: Deepen existing keeper edges and shade only established shell and crystal facets.
final_step.instruction: Darken selected shell edges with 2B. Add restrained gray-brown pencil to the rock rim and pale violet and blue to alternating existing crystal facets, leaving paper highlights and the five point silhouettes unchanged.
adds: graphite and restrained colored-pencil shading on established shapes
